public.title: JSON Patch
public.description: input {value,patches}; path in each patch is a nonempty array of object keys (no arrays along paths). Ancestors exist. Patches have op add, replace or remove; add writes a key, replace overwrites an existing key, remove deletes an existing key. Add/replace include value. Apply in order to a deep copy and return it. This JSON-path adapter omits pointer escaping and other JSON Patch operations. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
